verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation describing an official desktop client, selective sync, or on-demand/online-only file behavior — only community anecdote (comm-4) that Google's Mac sync client exists but is 'quite unreliable' and syncs files as placeholder URLs rather than downloaded content. This suggests the on-demand-files-like feature exists but underperforms, with no docs corroborating cross-platform (macOS/Windows) selective sync details. missing for 10: official docs on Drive for desktop, selective sync configuration, on-demand file behavior, Windows/macOS parity, independent verification of reliability.
